title: Faithful and Complete LLM-Assisted Automated Construction of Hierarchical Hardware Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.12762v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hardware datasheets contain engineering specifications essential for component selection, system integration, and hardware compatibility verification. However, manual inspection is tedious and error-prone because datasheets are lengthy and heterogeneous, with dense information fragmented across tables, figures, and text. Although large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, na\"ive one-shot processing omits relevant specifications even when the document fits within the model's context window.   We present an automated LLM-driven pipeline that transforms hardware datasheets into general-purpose hierarchical hardware knowledge graphs through chunk-based property extraction, hierarchical routing, and iterative refinement. The framework uses LLMs for information extraction and semantic reasoning while preserving source provenance and applying graph updates through validated instructions and deterministic local execution. translated_title: 忠实且完整的LLM辅助层级式硬件知识图谱自动构建
translated_abstract: 硬件数据手册包含对元器件选型、系统集成和硬件兼容性验证至关重要的工程规格参数。然而，由于数据手册篇幅冗长且形式异构，密集的信息分散在表格、图表和文本中，人工查阅既繁琐又容易出错。尽管大语言模型（LLM）可以自动化这一过程，但简单的一次性处理即使在整个文档能够放入模型上下文窗口的情况下，仍会遗漏相关的规格参数。我们提出了一种自动化的LLM驱动流水线，通过基于分块的属性提取、层级路由和迭代优化，将硬件数据手册转换为通用的层级式硬件知识图谱。该框架利用LLM进行信息提取和语义推理，同时保留信息来源的可追溯性，并通过经过验证的指令和确定性的本地执行来应用图谱更新。这种分
tldr: 提出了一种LLM驱动的自动化流水线，通过分块属性提取、层级路由和迭代优化，将硬件数据手册忠实且完整地转换为保留来源可追溯性的层级式硬件知识图谱。
en_tdlr: An automated LLM-driven pipeline that faithfully and completely transforms hardware datasheets into hierarchical hardware knowledge graphs through chunk-based property extraction, hierarchical routing, and iterative refinement, while preserving source provenance.
